text:
ryan: Heads-up: nightly benchmark for model-sync failed on staging at 03:12 UTC. Step `bench-runner` crashed during KV pruning, looks possibly OOM. Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/5421
maya: ack, looking. Is this the run with the new quant profile (q4)?
ryan: yep, we flipped q4 for ~10% of jobs yesterday morning.
sam: @ryan can you paste the failing test name/snippet?
ryan: log snippet: `ERROR: test_kv_cache_eviction (tests.bench.test_scheduler)\nTraceback: ... RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` 
ci-bot: Job #5421 failed: https://ci.redwood/example/5421 — use `/rerun` to retry
maya: I'm going to rerun the exact job on the same commit, assigning to myself.
oncall-bot: Rerun started by maya — job #5421.1 (est ~12m)
sam: if it repros we should bisect q3->q4; I can start a bisect job later today.
ryan: rerun finished — PASSED :tada: Looks transient for now. I'll still add a quick OOM-smoke step to the nightlies to catch this earlier.
maya: thanks — marking as resolved in the incident board, and will open a PR for the smoke step.
sam: can we also emit a soft OOM metric from bench-runner so we can alert on rising OOMs? -> filed ticket #2456
ryan: created ticket: https://kanban.redwood/tickets/2456 — title: "bench-runner: emit soft OOM metric" :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup: closing thread.
